lines.2: 「Now that four of you have joined, I want to bring the student council up to full strength in one stroke.」
lines.3: 「One treasurer position is vacant. I am primarily the student council president, so I want someone dedicated to the role.」
lines.4: 「Therefore, you will scout a suitable treasurer.」
lines.6: 「As treasurer, she will be my partner. I will not accept any mediocre candidate.」
lines.8: 「Someone beautiful who looks like she has large breasts.」
lines.10: Yoshimi was sighing for some reason.
lines.11: 「As if you're saying, 'That goes without saying,' right?」
lines.15: 「But why us? You sound awfully particular, so why not look for her yourself?」
lines.17: 「To raise morale, I hereby bestow upon you the Kiriya Stamp Card.」
lines.19: 「I will give you one stamp for each result you produce.」
lines.20: 「Fill the entire card, and you earn the marvelous privilege of having any one wish granted.」
lines.22: 「Yes. Within the bounds of my ability, of course, but there is very little I cannot do.」
lines.24: 「A-All the chicken curry I can eat!」
lines.26: 「I wanna go on a date with the Princess!」
lines.27: 「You people are remarkably cheap to please.」
lines.28: 「A date... Very well, I will consider it.」
lines.29: 「And during our current special offer, Yoppi comes included.」
lines.31: Yoshimi got added on as casually as a side of fries.
lines.32: 「That's incredible! A beauty on each arm!」
lines.33: 「There's no way I'm making it home that night!」
lines.36: She's looking at you like a monkey at the zoo. Notice, Fukahire!
lines.37: And she only said she would 'consider' it.
lines.38: It had the shady ring of a politician's promise.
lines.39: 「I thought a simple reward like this might make it easier for you to work hard.」
